[[wikipedia:weapon|Weapons]] of battle come in all sizes and shapes; some are improvised from farm implements, and others were [[power-wrought blade|forged]] with the [[One Power]] during the [[War of Power]].

In the Wheel of Time universe, most weapons are directly taken from real-life.
